text: AO Racing, the US sports-car racing team, was founded in 2022 by PJ Hyett and Gunnar Jeannette.
short: AO Racing was founded in 2022 by PJ Hyett and Gunnar Jeannette.

source.quote: Founded in 2022 by PJ Hyett and Gunnar Jeannette, AO Racing has quickly become one of the most recognizable brands in international sports car racing.
